title: The Fastest Sled in Town
lines: Snow fell all night on the small town.
Meg and Nick went out with their sleds.
"My sled is the fastest of all," said Meg.
They went up the tallest hill by the tree.
Nick went first. He slid fast and far.
Meg went next, but her sled was slower.
She got to the end long after Nick.
Nick had a big grin. Meg did not.
She sat down and looked at her sled.
Then she lifted it up and looked under it.
Snow was packed hard under both sides.
Meg got the hard snow off with her mitt.
Up the hill she went for one more run.
This time Meg was faster than Nick!
Then a brown dog slid past on a lid.
The dog got to the end first of all.
Meg had to grin. That dog is the fastest!

questions.ask: Why was Meg's sled slower the first time?
questions.listenFor: Snow was packed hard under both sides of the sled. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: Who slid past Meg and Nick at the end?
questions.listenFor: The brown dog, on a lid. If your child guesses, have them reread the line.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was mad at the end? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. The grin is a clue, and so is the dog.
